aggregationRules.row: One displayed flow equals one accepted publisher source row, regardless of recipient count or number of organization roles.
aggregationRules.amount: Dollar totals are computed only inside one selected publisher ledger. Cross-publisher totals are prohibited because the same underlying funding may appear in more than one publication.
aggregationRules.roles: Originating and advising funders are separate roles. A publisher or evaluator is not treated as the originating funder unless the accepted source says so.
aggregationRules.missingness: Unknown geography, stage, restriction, amount, or role remains unknown and is never inferred from a recipient, purpose, or evaluator.
aggregationRules.date: Year filters use each ledger’s declared date basis: award, decision, or announcement. The basis is shown on every row.
